author: rsi_demo
title: G15 · 拒绝
body:
Generation 15 replaces repeated word-frequency Map writes with stable ID arrays and frequency-bucket selection, uses native typed sorting for larger topK results, adds small-k and monotonic LIS fast paths, and replaces the matrix kernel with representation-specialized 2×2 tiling. These changes remove several repeated hash, callback, allocation, and load operations while preserving ordering, duplicate semantics, argument purity, and prime boundaries; the conservative projected product is about 1.74, exceeding the 1.477 acceptance requirement.
===== END FILE =====
